description: Guides adapting a VLA model's inference server interface to the CloudRobo standard interface/protocol. Use this skill when the user wants to create a compatible inference interface protocol for a model, or make a model compatible with the CloudRobo client library. Trigger conditions: "adapt inference interface", "inference service compatibility", "flattened interface", or any request to make a model server compatible with an external inference client library.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
